networks.behavior: Locally received public descriptors drive address derivation. Account zero per supported account type gets three synthetic UTXOs and one serialized synthetic history transaction; higher accounts are empty to terminate discovery.
limits: No real-chain funding, confirmation or transaction validation.
Multiple Bitcoin account types independently receive synthetic fixture funding; portfolio totals are illustrative and must not be interpreted as one real wallet.
BTC balance-history and rate responses are sparse/static; chart axes can render without a populated series.
BTC broadcast requests are rejected locally.

networks.behavior: Matching first QA account exposes existing native/token balances, staking position and history fixtures; other accounts use empty defaults.
limits: Static historical and staking states; no actual activation, claiming or transfer is established.
Token/fiat rates and synthetic quote ratios may disagree by design.

networks.behavior: Existing descriptor-specific Cardano test responses with empty account fallbacks.
limits: The common ETH/SOL QA seed used in this runtime session does not match the separate Cardano funded mnemonic fixture; the observed Cardano account remains unfunded.
Cardano Buy/minimum-stake guidance is visible; funded stake, voting, rewards and withdrawals are not established by this runtime state.

networks.behavior: First QA account balance plus local discovery metadata, epoch/stake fixtures, fee/simulation and subscription responses. Unknown upstream passthrough is replaced by local errors or explicit empty fallbacks.
limits: Default stake-account state is empty; optional control modes are available but not evidence of a captured journey unless recorded separately.
No populated Solana signature-history or Earn reward-history/total endpoints are implemented for this audit; empty fallbacks or local failures do not establish production absence.
The inherited sendTransaction handler can return a fixed synthetic signature locally; it never sends to a remote chain. It is not an executed transaction.

networks.behavior: Matching QA account and resource state from existing Tron E2E responses; empty defaults for unmatched accounts.
limits: Freeze/resource entry and provider consent are inspectable; this does not establish executed freezing, representative votes or reward collection.

trading.adaptation: Trading E2E now observes live positive responses; positive offline offers therefore adapt the established unit fixture schema. One explicitly named Local QA Provider, catalog assets, illustrative currency conversion ratios, card/bank options and a single centralized floating-rate swap offer.
limits: Eight checked-in catalog assets and two platform definitions; not a complete live asset catalog.
Quotes are synthetic UI data, not current market offers; backend fiat prices and trading conversions are intentionally not economically consistent.
Fixed-rate and DEX results are absent; showing their section/filter is not evidence of available offers.
No order creation, provider redirect, KYC, payment, payout, trade signing, confirmation or provider execution. Unknown/trade API operations fail locally.

yield.adaptation: Reuse the complete three-vault E2E catalog for ETH/WETH, USDC and USDT, including reward-rate breakdown and receipt-token metadata. Honor output-token list filters and vault-detail lookups. Merkl rewards are empty.
limits: Captured initial wrap and approval forms do not establish a wrap, allowance, deposit, withdrawal, redemption or reward claim.
Static rates, contract metadata and availability are QA fixtures, not live commercial or liquidity information.
No Blockaid simulation-success response was installed for execution flows in the route adapter.

staking.adaptation: Reuse unit batch APYs/timing data for ETH/SOL/ADA/TRX, replacing abbreviated schema-test identifiers with the application registry public Cardano pool and Tron representative identities. Validate every pool checksum/payload before route installation.
limits: Original abbreviated Cardano pool identifier caused a QA-only bech32 error; it was corrected locally and the error boundary retained as explicit environment evidence.
Provider identity validity and API shape do not prove live provider availability, current yield or any transaction.

environment.model_setup: Load the shared ETH/SOL fixture only with Suite at about:blank and the task bridge stopped. The bridge is restored after successful setup. Existing user profiles remain untouched.
environment.qa_fixture_reference: deviceSetup.mnemonic property in the two source tests; read only by qa-fixture-input.cjs. No phrase is copied into this report.
environment.remote_policy: Mock servers/route handlers never forward requests upstream. Browser-level blocking of external account traffic and telemetry is maintained separately by the root audit controller. Public static/firmware asset handling is outside these backend mocks.

verification.mock_backends: Local contract checks passed BTC metadata/funding shape/three UTXO rows/history and ETH response, Solana discovery blockhash, five-network health. No real-chain checks.
verification.route_helper: Local fake-route contract checks passed provider lists, quotes, Yield list/detail/filter, staking batch, valid Cardano pool decoding and blocked trade creation with zero route.fetch/continue calls. Actual screen evidence is separate.
verification.device_setup: After task-controller recovery, T3T1 2.12.5 fixture setup returned true with bridge stopped, followed by successful bridge restart. Other models require their own observations.
verification.scope: No live transaction, trade, stake or yield execution is claimed.

activation_checkpoints.attribution: Root audit agent reports activation and owns live browser/TUE/backend state. This checkpoint records that report plus file fingerprints; the QC agent did not control services.

runtime.endpoints: Same loopback ports and no-upstream behavior as original backend manifest.

mode_history.evidence: Saved captures web-t3t1-solana-staked-position, web-t3t1-solana-unstake-form, web-t3t1-solana-deactivation-pending. Explicit fixture modes, not actual stake/unstake transactions.
Saved Tron dashboard, claim/vote/allocation/representative/unstake forms and matured-withdrawal capture states. No vote, claim, unstake or withdrawal submitted.

Root reports separate academic QA emulator fixture initialized and funded account loaded. Corresponding UI captures were not yet part of the reviewed 207–228 snapshot; a later Cardano QC batch will establish visible states separately.

activation_checkpoints.source_guard: Cardano responses retain strict equality to the original academic-fixture account descriptor; Tron responses retain strict equality to the established shared-fixture first-account address. No descriptor/address rebinding. Cardano active stake states retain checksum-validated public pool/stake identities from exact E2E updates. Fixtures are read from source expressions without logging values.
activation_checkpoints.qa_seed_reference: Separate Cardano wrapper reads MNEMONICS.mnemonic_academic internally. Shared ETH/SOL/TRX fixture remains unchanged in its original wrapper. No mnemonic/descriptor/address/amount values are recorded here.
activation_checkpoints.historical_interpretation: Earlier Cardano-unfunded and default-empty-Solana statements describe the initial shared-seed/default-mode phase. They remain preserved as historical provenance, superseded only for the explicit later modes recorded here.
remaining_limits: Solana populated reward history and Earn rewards-history/total endpoints remain unavailable; loading placeholders are not successful history retrieval.
Tron and Cardano modes are static E2E state snapshots. Valid identities do not establish real chain funding, rewards, eligibility or transaction validity.
Synthetic prices/rates/fees remain illustrative; no real-chain or provider execution is claimed.

activation_checkpoints.status: root-reported activation plus direct saved-PNG review
activation_checkpoints.context: Fresh disposable Cardano app profile with matching academic E2E fixture. Earlier shared ETH/SOL profile remains a separate historical context.
activation_checkpoints.observation_scope: Funded staking introduction/consent/delegation and voting forms; rewarded dashboard/claim/unstake/voting-preference forms; empty Raw-key/COSE signing form. No transactions or signature generation.
activation_checkpoints.source_guard: Candidate ADA mode continues to match only the established academic account descriptor. No UTXO/stake-credential rebinding. Source-read fixture mnemonic is never logged or persisted by these helpers.
activation_checkpoints.semantic_limit: Dashboard Change delegate opens governance voting preference, not pool-provider migration. The provider-update feature is not verified by this batch.
activation_checkpoints.privacy: No amounts, descriptors, mnemonic words, account addresses or transaction identifiers copied into this checkpoint.
